scripts.dev: pnpm zig:build && pnpm rust:build && pnpm go:build && pnpm --filter @ziglive/protocol build && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @ziglive/server dev" "pnpm --filter @ziglive/web dev"
scripts.test: pnpm zig:build test && pnpm rust:build && pnpm rust:test && pnpm go:build && pnpm go:test && pnpm ts:test && pnpm py:test && pnpm cfamily:test && pnpm --filter @ziglive/protocol build && pnpm -r --if-present test
scripts.build: pnpm zig:build && pnpm rust:build && pnpm go:build && pnpm -r build
